name: agy-terminal
description: Open and read a visible AGY/Gemini terminal shared with the user. Human confirmations are manual by default; resume observation after the user handles a prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Open and read a shared visible AGY terminal (v0.5.0)
interface.longDescription: agy_open opens or reuses a user-interactive console for the authorized project. agy_read reads its screen without typing. agy_run submits bounded review or worker tasks only at an idle prompt. The user handles confirmations and authentication; agy_wait resumes observing a pending task without resubmitting it. Scoped file-edit auto-approval requires explicit autoApprove:true in worker mode.
defaultPrompt: Open or reuse a visible AGY console with agy_open({ cwd: '...' }).
Inspect the same terminal with agy_read; let the user handle any manual prompt or login.
Only submit a task when inputReady is true. Use agy_wait after the user handles a pending task confirmation.
Use AGY for a read-only review: agy_run({ task: '...', mode: 'review', cwd: '...' }).
Use AGY to implement a bounded change: agy_run({ task: '...', mode: 'worker', cwd: '...', editableFiles: [...], timeoutSeconds: 900 }).
